newsitem.title: UK: BA Cargo says Giblin gen mgr world sales/mar.
newsitem.headline: BA Cargo says Giblin gen mgr world sales/mar.

text.p: Paul Giblin is to become general manager, worldwide sales and marketing for British Airways Plc World Cargo division, a BA cargo spokesman said.
Giblin will take up his new post on June 1, the spokesman told Reuters.
In October last year, BA named Giblin as chief commercial officer for Deutsche BA in a move from his job as area manager for Germany.

Industry sources said Giblin will fill a new post at the carrier left vacant last November when MSAS Cargo International OGP.L UK managing director Geoff Corpe decided to remain with MSAS instead of joining BA Cargo as sales and marketing director. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
